basic_details.job_title: RGNAU Designer cum Content Developer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU), Fursatganj, Amethi, Uttar Pradesh, under the Ministry of Civil Aviation, Govt. of India, has invited online applications for the position of Designer-cum-Content Developer purely on a contractual basis. Eligible candidates can submit their online applications through the official portal at https://rgnaunt.samarth.edu.in/ until 6th December 2026.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit for applicants is 35 years.

qualification.details: Bachelor’s Degree in Graphic Design / Visual Communication / Fine Arts / Mass Communication / Multimedia OR Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline OR equivalent from a recognized University / Institution. Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Canva etc. Strong writing and content development skills in English (knowledge of Hindi or regional language desirable).

content_sections.heading: About RGNAU Designer-cum-Content Developer
content_sections.text: The Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU) was established by an Act of Parliament called the “Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU) Act, 2013” (No. 26 of 2013) having its headquarters at Fursatganj, Dist. Amethi, Uttar Pradesh. The university has been envisaged as the premier institution of higher learning within the aviation milieu aimed at providing cutting edge and critical research to enhance the aviation industry in India.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the essential qualifications, experience, and age limit prescribed by the university. Bachelor’s Degree in Graphic Design / Visual Communication / Fine Arts / Mass Communication / Multimedia OR Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline OR equivalent from a recognized University / Institution. Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Canva etc. Strong writing and content development skills in English (knowledge of Hindi or regional language desirable). Minimum 3–4 years of relevant experience in graphic designing and content development. Experience in digital media, social media management, website content, or publication design is desirable. The upper age limit for applicants is 35 years.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration between Rs. 50,000 and Rs. 60,000 per month based on experience. The engagement is purely on contractual basis, initially for a period of one year, which may be extended maximum upto 3 years on yearly renewal basis subject to evaluation of performance and requirement. No DA, HRA, PF, Pension, Insurance, Gratuity, Seniority, Promotion, LTC, Medical claim, Education allowances etc. are admissible for contractual engagement under the University. Subject to availability, the engaged person may be given suitable accommodation in university campus as per allotment rules of RGNAU, as amended from time to time, on payment of prescribed license fee / rent.

content_sections.heading: RGNAU Designer-cum-Content Developer Job Description
content_sections.text: The required skills and proficiency areas associated with the role include: Design & Creative Skills: Strong understanding of layout design, typography, color theory, and academic presentation standards; ability to integrate AI-assisted design workflows with traditional creative processes. Content Development Skills: Excellent academic and professional writing skills; ability to simplify complex research concepts for broader audiences; proficiency in using AI tools responsibly for drafting, editing, and ideation. Technical & Analytical Skills: Familiarity with website and social media content management and digital publishing; understanding of SEO, analytics, and AI-assisted content optimization. Soft Skills: Strong attention to detail and accuracy; ethical awareness in AI usage (plagiarism, bias, authorship concerns); ability to work collaboratively with academic and administrative staff; time management and ability to meet multiple deadlines. Tools & Software Proficiency: Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe InDesign, Canva, Microsoft Word / Google Docs, WordPress, Grammarly, DALL·E, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Jasper AI, Google Analytics, basic video editing tools (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro), Figma (for wireframing and prototyping), Adobe XD, Sketch (preferred), InVision, and basic knowledge of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RGNAU Designer-cum-Content Developer
content_sections.text: Visit the official application portal at https://rgnaunt.samarth.edu.in/. Complete the online application form following the instructions given therein before the last date. Pay the online applications processing fee online based on your category. Submit the online application before the closing date of 6th December 2026. Candidates need to RETAIN hard copy of Printout of Online Application Form along with all copies of certificates / educational qualification / experience / testimonials and other requisite documents in support of eligibility, which are required to be submitted at the time of written test/trade test/interview, if shortlisted.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection committee may decide its own method of screening/shortlisting and evaluating the performance of the candidates in written test/trade test/interview. Call Letters and other correspondence for attending the written/trade tests/interview, etc., shall be sent to the eligible candidates by email only and web notification in this regard shall be displayed on the University website. Candidates shall have to produce original certificates relating to his age, qualifications, experience, caste, etc., at the time of appearing in written test/trade test/Interview.
